text:
All fixed and verified:

- `compare("1.10.0", "1.9.0")` → `1` (was `-1`)
- `compare("2.0.0", "10.0.0")` → `-1`
- `compare("1.02.0", "1.2.0")` → `0` (leading zeros now ignored)
- Trailing-component padding and pre-release ordering still behave as documented
- Existing test suite passes

The root cause: `parse` returned the raw string components instead of converting them to ints (contradicting its own docstring), so release components were compared lexicographically. I changed `parse` to return `[int(p) for p in parts]` and updated `zip_longest`'s `fillvalue` from `"0"` to `0` to keep types consistent.
